messages:
monica: Heads-up — planning a small canary apply in the 21:00 UTC release window for the routing.tf changes. Need pin, rollback plan, and anyone watching IAM drift.

monica: TL;DR: apply will touch TGW route propagation + a new service-account IAM binding. Low blast but needs careful tfstate ordering.

sanjay: I'm +1. Plan: 1) run `terraform plan -target=module.tgw` in staging -> confirm, 2) canary apply to canary-az (serial), 3) wait 5m smoke, 4) apply rest.

sanjay: I'll push a pin for provider in the apply job (provider v4.12.0) and set `deploybot:hold=true` until we get green smoke.

lee: @sanjay quick Q: the SA binding — is it additive (grant) or replace? If it's remove+add we need to sequence to avoid auth gaps.

sanjay: additive grant only. adding `roles/tgw.networkAdmin` to svcacct/infra-sync. No removal.

olivia: Noted for release notes — will call out the IAM grant and the expected no-downtime. Also adding a short rollback blurb.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Starting preflight checks for thread 1759012345. Preflight results: plan ok, no drift blockers, tfstate lock available. Reaction :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: queued canary apply to runner `canary-az-3` at 21:00 UTC. Use `--apply-id=1759012345` to reference this run.

monica: Rollback plan: if canary fails, run `terraform apply -target=module.tgw -refresh=false -var 'rollback=true'` to revert route propagation, then revoke the SA grant (we'll remove binding in a follow-up apply). Also keep provider pin in place.

lee: Add runbook snippet for oncall: `if latency > 200ms for >3m then abort, revert routes, open incident`. Also add `audit-log` check for the SA grant.

sanjay: I'll attach the minimal `apply` command we will run in the canary:```bash
terraform workspace select release-2026-03
terraform plan -out=canary.plan -target=module.tgw
terraform apply "canary.plan"
```

olivia: Cool. I'll update release notes with the command + rollback steps. Tagging @lee for oncall watch and @sanjay for execution. :thumbsup:

monica: Final check — any objections to proceeding? If none, we'll flip `deploybot:unlock` at 20:55 UTC and kick canary at 21:00.

lee: No objections from SRE. I'll be watching metrics.

sanjay: Ready on my side. Will monitor logs during canary.

monica: Alright. flipping at 20:55. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
